comment-heart.context: Round speech bubble with a filled heart inside. Used for loving comments, heart reactions on messages, supportive replies, fan mail and appreciation posts.

community-group.context: Three people side by side with the centre person standing in front. Used for communities, clubs, member groups, forums, social circles and team spaces.

dislike.context: Heart split down the middle by a jagged crack. Used for unlike or remove from favourites, broken-heart reactions, breakups, sad moods and negative feedback.

feedback.context: Rectangular speech bubble with a smiling face inside. Used for feedback forms, customer satisfaction, rate your experience prompts, reviews and happy responses.

follow.context: Head and shoulders of a person with a plus sign beside them. Used for follow buttons, add friend, invite a member, new connection requests and subscribe to a creator.

followers.context: Head and shoulders of one person with a second person behind them. Used for follower counts, audience lists, subscribers, fans and profile stats in social apps.

hashtag-social.context: Round speech bubble with a # sign in the middle. Used for hashtags in posts, topic channels, trending tags, group chats by topic and social campaign tags.

heart.context: Classic heart shape outline. Used for like buttons, favourites, wishlists, saved items, love reactions, health apps and dating profiles.

influencer.context: Head and shoulders of a person with a star beside them. Used for creators, influencers, featured users, VIP members, celebrities and top contributor badges.

live-stream.context: Computer screen on a stand showing a signal dot with waves on both sides. Used for going live, live streams, live events, webinars and broadcast channels.

notification-bell.context: Bell with a solid dot at its top right corner. Used for unread notifications, new alerts, activity badges, update counts and notification centre buttons.

poll.context: Vertical line on the left with three horizontal bars of different lengths. Used for polls and their results, voting options, quick surveys and ranked answers.

rating.context: Three stars, the middle one larger and raised above the two smaller ones. Used for ratings, reviews, star scores, rankings and customer satisfaction summaries.

reel.context: Frame with a clapperboard strip along the top and a play button in the middle. Used for short videos, reels, clips, video stories and vertical video feeds.

repost.context: Small post card with an arrow curving up and out to the right. Used to repost or reshare someone's post to your own feed, boost content and share quoted posts.

review.context: Rectangular speech bubble with a star inside. Used for writing reviews, customer testimonials, product ratings, feedback sections and starred comments.

share-alt.context: Three dots joined by lines, one on the left and two on the right. Used for share buttons, sharing to social networks, distributing links and network connections.

star.context: Five-pointed star outline. Used for favourites, starred items, bookmarks, ratings, featured content, wishlists and important markers.

story.context: Head and shoulders of a person inside a dashed, segmented ring. Used for social stories, status updates, profile rings with new content and 24-hour posts.

survey.context: Form page with rows of checked boxes and answer lines. Used for surveys, questionnaires, quizzes, feedback forms, checklists and research studies.

trending.context: Flame with an upward arrow cut into it. Used for trending topics, hot items, popular posts, viral content, best sellers and what's hot sections.

unfollow.context: Head and shoulders of a person with a minus sign beside them. Used for unfollow buttons, remove friend, remove a member, leave a group and block or mute options.

verified-badge.context: Badge with a scalloped, wavy edge and a check mark in the middle. Used for verified accounts, official profiles, approved sellers, quality guarantees and certified content.

vote.context: Ballot paper with a check mark being dropped into a ballot box. Used for voting, elections, polls, casting a ballot, decisions and community governance.
